notes: Searches now name ONE artist. Roon writes an album's artists as one slash-joined string and the whole thing went into the query, which found nothing: 457 of the 1,273 albums whose Qobuz search came back empty on a real 9,514-album library were that. A read that failed is reported as a failure rather than as "not found", and is never cached. A run whose track-listing check never once works stops and says why, on the page. The CSV download buttons work in the app at last — they did nothing at all from v0.1.0. Previous runs no longer label every Roon run "Spotify to Qobuz".
